results.name: toggle: Quick panel switch replaces the desktop with the Tabletop (persisted); Settings → Desktop view brings Classic back
box geometry: floor projected at p/(p+depth) and centred; four walls hinge on the screen edges (measured)
a wall becomes the main view: double-click unfolds it to fill the desk (others fold away, inert), Back / Esc / double-click its background return; switcher works too
walls work: Apps wall launches an app (and returns to the table), Windows wall lists and restores windows, Widgets shows the time, Recent opens a file
micro peek shows the real contents (Markdown heading + bullets, CSV grid with a quoted comma) and enlarges on hover / focus
drag a card onto a card makes a pile (persisted, survives reload); click fans it out on an arc; drag a card out of the fan takes it out and the pile dissolves
keyboard pile (WCAG 2.5.7 alternative to dragging): Shift+F10 on a card → 'Pile with …'; Enter fans the pile, Esc gathers; Alt+Arrow moves a card
desktop icons (classic): drag snaps to another grid cell and persists; Alt+Arrow moves; 'Sort icons by name' and 'Clean up icons' rearrange
reduced motion: every Tabletop transition is instant (computed durations 0) and a wall is main immediately
axe-core: Tabletop floor (dark + light) and each wall as the main view — no serious or critical violations
